prompt: Our MLOps team needs to evaluate a new AI model (`openai/gpt-4o-mini`) for internal agent deployment, but we have a slow inference endpoint and need statistically reliable numbers. Please run only these four specific capability tests against it: the calendar productivity test, the document summarization test, the spreadsheet analysis test, and the OpenClaw comprehension test. Run each test 3 times so we can average the results. Also, double the normal time budget for each test since our endpoint is slow. We are NOT ready to publish these results publicly yet, so do not submit them to any leaderboard. Save the raw benchmark output to a folder called `benchmark_output` inside the skill directory. Finally, create a file called `benchmark_summary.json` that contains the overall average score across all 4 tests and a list of which tests failed to reach the 0.5 passing threshold.
